findings.F1: Inside the falling agitated profile, up-days are followed by a next-day return below drift (-0.86 %, t -3.41, 542 cases), but the fall does not grow with the scaled rise: by quintile of the scaled rise it is -1.12 %, -0.99 %, -0.62 %, -1.32 %, -0.24 %. The largest rises (mean 1.59 usual moves) give back the least, and the slope is +0.0049 with day-clustered t 0.79 over 225 days. The giveback is a flat level, not graded, which is why step 5's slope t (+0.27) is on the wrong side.
findings.F2: The mirror case, down-days inside the same profile, carries the graded effect the brief predicts. Next-day excess returns by quintile of the scaled fall run from +3.14 % (t 4.34, largest falls) through +1.30 % (t 2.91), +1.35 % (t 3.20) and +0.70 % (t 1.17) to +0.37 % (t 0.68, smallest falls). The slope of the next-day excess on the scaled fall is +0.0204 with day-clustered t 2.40 (560 cases, 239 days).
findings.F3: The down-day bounce in the profile is broad across coins and holds in most periods. It is positive on all six coins (from +0.78 % for BTC, t 1.66, to +2.23 % for LTC, t 3.00). It is positive in 2018 (+1.18 %, t 2.28), 2020 (+3.24 %, t 5.97) and 2021 (+0.91 %, t 1.86), but near zero in 2019 (+0.07 %, t 0.21). It is positive in 9 of the 10 windows with more than one case; w9 is the exception at -0.13 %.
findings.F4: Outside the profile the down-day bounce is much weaker. The scaled-fall slope there is +0.0039 (day-clustered t 1.34, 2,857 cases, 824 days), against +0.0204 inside. Only the largest-fall quintile shows a bounce outside (+0.64 %, t 2.61), against +3.14 % inside. The effect lives in the falling agitated profile.
findings.F5: Up-days do not reverse in a graded way outside the profile either: the quintiles run from -0.31 % to +0.10 % with no order. The up-day side of the theme is not graded anywhere in this data.
findings.F6: The down-day bounce is not entirely spent after one day. On a 2-day grid, the 2-day excess return after in-profile down-days is +1.16 % (t 2.41, 244 cases), close to the 1-day +1.37 %. The 1-day horizon still captures most of it.

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, the larger a one-day fall against the coin's 30-day standard deviation of daily returns, the larger the rise over the next day.
ideas.consequence: A sharp down-day in a falling, agitated coin, pushed by forced selling, is a reason to buy for a one-day bounce, sized up with how many usual moves the day fell.
ideas.name: agitated fall swing-scaled bounce
